description: GripLine labelled test set for CLIP zero-shot track-condition classification.
note: Ground-truth labels are human-assigned based on visual appearance. These are generated images, not real track photos — use for integration testing and demo only.

samples.description: Aerial view of a dry racing circuit on a sunny day. Clear blue sky, light grey tarmac with no moisture.
Close-up ground-level view of a dry track straight. Sunlit asphalt with tire rubber marks.
Aerial view of a damp track corner after light rain. Darker patches of moisture, no standing water.
Ground-level racing circuit corner with damp surface and overcast sky.
Aerial view of a track during heavy rain. Standing water, spray from tires, reflective wet surface.
Ground-level view of a racing circuit in heavy rainfall. Puddles, spray, dark storm clouds.
